_what: Settings of the engine's one HTTP client (src/https.rs): reqwest over hyper and rustls, run on its own small tokio runtime so every caller, on any thread, waits for its answer the same way. `worker_threads` is that runtime's worker count; `lookup_threads` bounds the system DNS lookups that run at once (each blocks one thread until the system answers), so a stuck resolver cannot grow threads without end; `chunks_ahead` is how many body chunks are read before the caller takes them, so a slow reader holds at most that many in memory. `kept_idle_ms` is how long a connection may sit unused and still be sent the next request: measured 2026-11-13 against Backblaze B2's S3 endpoint, a connection idle 5 s still answered and one idle 15 s had been closed by the store, so a shorter keep leaves a store's own close rarely to race a request; a connection kept longer is dropped, never tried.
